catalog.title: 1975 Seiko Catalog Vol.2
catalog.note: JDM catalogue ('75 Vol.2, red cloth cover). Each caption prints the ref (●HNK624) and the list price (円), a feature line, the case material with ·WR where water-resistant (SS, SGP, TSGP, WGP, ASGP/AWGP/APDP/ACRP/AGF/AWGF A-grade plated, GC gold cap, GF/WGF gold-filled, PDP palladium, RHP rhodium, SILV silver, NSB, TINSB titanium, 14K/18K, PM platinum, ALM light alloy) and the movement code with jewels (石), followed by a <case-dial> number kept as caseDialCode (the full printed line is kept in `code`). `caliber` is filled only where the movement is printed as a four-digit calibre (4130, 2220, 6810, 2411, 6159, 6117 …); family codes such as 48GQW, 38SQW, 56KAW, 52LWL, 11S, 17QSL, LM36, 22MLW or 88ST leave it blank, and no CCCC-NNNN case–movement ref or bracelet/strap code is printed. Strap/bracelet and crystal notes come from the caption and photo. Pages 1–8 are photo spreads with a numbered price list at the top (records follow the list order). The scan skips printed pages 18, 24, 36, 42, 46, 52, 66, 72, 74, 76, 86, 90, 92, 122, 125 and 126; the last scan page is printed page 130 (railway watch). The archive's twin file '1975 Seiko V2.pdf' holds the same pages in lower quality and is not digitised separately.
catalog.method: vision transcription in-harness (no paid API) of 250 DPI renders, Oct 2026: every pictured watch given its own record and cropped photo (boxes from a caption-bullet-anchored detector plus hand-set boxes, checked on per-page check sheets), with ref, price, movement, jewels, case, case-dial code and dial verified against 400–800 DPI caption crops of the PDF.
